# Data Store Backend

Accepts data payloads via POST and persists them to the filesystem. Write endpoints are protected by HTTP basic auth. API documentation is available at `/docs/` when the service is running.

## Configuration (appsettings)

All available settings and their descriptions are documented in [src/appsettings.schema.json](src/appsettings.schema.json). The file `src/appsettings.json` is a committed template with placeholder values showing the expected structure.

For local development, edit `src/appsettings.LOCAL.json`. It is imported directly by the app at build time.

For containerized deployments (Docker Compose, production, etc.), mount a filled-out JSON file at `/app/config/appsettings.<ENV>.json` and set the environment variable `API__ENVIRONMENT=<ENV>`.

Individual settings can additionally be overridden by environment variables using double-underscore path notation, e.g. `LOGGING__LEVEL=INFO`.
=== env example ===
./system_tests/.env.example
./apps/keycloak_sidecar_abstractions/.env.example
./apps/data_market_backend_abstractions/.env.example
./apps/connector_abstractions/.env.example
./apps/headless_cms/.env.example
./apps/keycloak_sidecar_http_client/.env.example
./packages/pypi/automation_framework/.env.example
./packages/pypi/spg_configuration/.env.example
./packages/pypi/spg_rest_auth/.env.example
./packages/pypi/spg_messaging_pubsub_abstractions/.env.example
# Local output directories
JPYPI_OUT_DIR="./repo_dump"
JNPM_OUT_DIR="./npm_repo_dump"

# Python dependency installs. pip reads this directly; Docker builds receive it
# as INDEX_URL.
PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/pypi/simple"

# GitLab target registry for Python packages
GITLAB_PYPI_UPLOAD_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/pypi"
GITLAB_PYPI_USERNAME="<gitlab-username-or-token-name>"
GITLAB_PYPI_PASSWORD="<gitlab-token>"

# GitLab target registry for npm packages
NPM_REGISTRY_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/npm/"
NPM_AUTH_TOKEN="<gitlab-token>"
GITLAB_NPM_UPLOAD_URL="https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/<project_id>/packages/npm/"
GITLAB_NPM_TOKEN="<gitlab-token>"

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat apps/data_store_backend/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=== env example ==="; find . -name '.env.example' | head; cat packages/.env.example 2>/dev/null
